The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] '''Envoy''' to [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]] was a distinguished man who served during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

Considered handsome, the [[Envoy/Legends|Envoy]] had seen action at a [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|Liberation of Kashyyyk]], earning the [[Medal of Honor]] in the process and had been cited for exemplary service through the [[Black Fleet Crisis|Yevethan Crisis]].
Later he became a member of the [[New Republic Advisory Council]] to the [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] before eventually becoming envoy.

With the position, he was present at the [[Battle of Gyndine]], assisting in the evacuation of the planet from its [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], promising to get everyone offworld. When unable to do just that, the Envoy was overcome with guilt aboard the final departing ship, prompting [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] to console the man.
